name: How do fire damage restoration companies remove smoke odor?

mainEntity.name: How do fire damage restoration companies remove smoke odor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional fire damage restoration companies employ various techniques to effectively remove smoke odor. These include thorough cleaning of all affected surfaces to remove soot and odor-causing residues, air scrubbing with HEPA and activated carbon filters, ozone generation, and thermal fogging. These methods neutralize and eliminate odor molecules, rather than just masking them, ensuring a clean and fresh environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smoke odor is removed through thorough cleaning, air scrubbing, ozone generation, and thermal fogging, which neutralize odor molecules.
